tools.name: coverage
tools.description: List the states RestoSignals currently has data for and how many scored venues each holds (with a count of hot leads, opening_score >= 80). Call this FIRST to see live inventory before new_openings — querying a state with no data returns nothing. Free (0 credits) and needs no API key.

tools.name: new_openings
tools.description: Find restaurants/bars about to open in a state, ranked by opening_score (0-100). Fuses liquor licenses, food permits and new-business filings into one scored venue. signal_types on each lead are 'liquor', 'food_permit' and 'business'. Live states: NY, TX, IL, OR, CO, WA, CA (call `coverage` for the

tools.name: watch_area
tools.description: Register a webhook that fires when a new matching venue opens in an area. criteria = {state, city, signal_type, min_opening_score}. Paid accounts only.

tools.name: lookup_liquor_license
tools.description: Look up liquor licenses in Texas, California, New York, Virginia or Florida by business name, owner (legal) name, premises address or license number. Returns license number, type, status and expiration date from the state's own records (TABC, California ABC, New York SLA, Virginia ABC, Florida DBPR)

tools.name: venue_signals
tools.description: Return the raw underlying signals (liquor/permit/business filings) that were fused into one venue, for transparency. 1 credit.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "coverage" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
